title: CIA changes
description: The latest change events of the record, newest first, at most 500: a service entering a new level of availability or integrity, an incident declared, opened, updated, resolved or removed, a release verified, a witness finding, and the record itself being delayed, resuming, or missing a run because the auditor's own network failed (a delay of the record, never an outage of a service). Stored at data/v1/cia/changes.json. A view: every event is derived from the run records and the incident facts by fixed rules, which the verifier applies again and compares, so the list cannot hide or invent a change. The feeds (feeds/all.*, feeds/<service>.*, feeds/incidents.*) carry the same events, the last 100 of each.

events.description: Newest first by at, ties by id; at most 500.

id.description: Stable and unique. A level, release, finding or record event: <at as YYYYMMDDHHMM>-<service or record>-<dimension or the kind>-<kind>, for example 202610010320-vault-availability-level or 202610010500-record-delayed. An event of an automatic incident: the file stem of its event fact (<incident id>-<seq>). An event of a declared incident: <incident id>-<snapshot slot as YYYYMMDDHHMM>.

at.description: The slot of the run that wrote or detected the event. For incident events written by the auditor, at of the event fact; for declared incidents, the slot of the snapshot that changed.

since.description: The slot the new state began: the first slot of the debounce window for a level change; at for every other kind.

services.description: The services the event is about; empty for record-delayed, record-resumed and vantage.

categories.description: C, I, A, in that order; empty for record-delayed, record-resumed and vantage.

dimension.description: The dimension of a level change; integrity for a release or a finding; null for every other kind.

from.description: The level before a level change; null for every other kind.

to.description: The level after a level change; null for every other kind.

summary.description: One line, in both languages, from the fixed templates of the contract (so the verifier can recompute it).

record.description: The run record of the slot at, or null for a declared incident event and for record-delayed (its slot has no record).

incident.description: The incident an incident event is about.

finding.description: The finding of a finding event.

release.description: The verdict of a release event.
